headlines: The matter of the approaching stranger concluded. He did not stay long.
Halix Marrow drank in silence and paid in foreign coin.
The cellar door was found unbolted at dawn. I bolted it.
footnotes: I have started writing these entries by candlelight again. The lamps are loud.
Two travelers met at the hearth and parted without speaking.
A child's wooden toy was left under the bench. I will keep it where it can be found.
